proposals.before: From the time the Mohe clan of the Greater He received Tang's gift of drums and banners, this became the Liao national regalia.
proposals.after: From the time Mohe of the Dahe clan received Tang's gift of drums and banners, this became the Liao national regalia.
proposals.reason: Chinese 大賀氏摩會 names Mohe (摩會) as an individual of the Dahe clan (大賀氏), not a "Mohe clan of the Greater He".

proposals.before: Liao, from the time the Mohe clan of the Greater He received Tang's gift of drums and banners, took this as national paraphernalia.
proposals.after: Liao, from the time Mohe of the Dahe clan received Tang's gift of drums and banners, took this as national paraphernalia.
proposals.reason: Same error as idiomatic: 摩會 is a personal name within 大賀氏, not a clan name.

proposals.before: Thereafter they exchanged embassies with Liang and sent missions to Tang, undaunted by the hardships of the journey.
proposals.after: Thereafter they exchanged embassies with Liang and sent missions to Tang, undaunted by toil and hardship.
proposals.reason: Chinese 不憚勞珝 appears corrupt (珝); rendering as a specific "journey" invents detail not securely in the text.

decisions.reason: 大賀氏摩會 is Mohe of the Dahe clan: 大賀氏 is the clan name and 摩會 the personal name. The prior English wrongly turns 摩會 into a clan and 大賀 into "Greater He".
Same parsing as the idiomatic field: 摩會 is the person within 大賀氏, not a "Mohe clan of the Greater He".

decisions.after: Thereafter they exchanged envoys with Liang and sent embassies to Tang, never shrinking from the effort.
decisions.reason: The Siku witness reads 不憚勞勩, ‘not shrinking from the toil.’ The revised sentence removes invented road travel and renders the attested text naturally.
